title: Audit sampled-node rope self-contact
requires: Each driver that advertises the API 0.2 rope self-contact record
scope: Qualify the narrow sampled-node self-exclusion claim or withdraw it from drivers that fail; do not infer capsule support.
acceptance: Nonadjacent-node separation, exclusions, fixed endpoints, momentum, capacity and long-run cases run through the public API.
Evidence labels the record node-only and removes advertisement from every failing driver.
